text: yes the but mesh health validator surfaces a contextual alert saying u done fucked up cuz are u gonna live with it or revert it right now. so its not like if u live iwth it, that the counter going up by one is breaking grounds for something to be warned about.
resolution: Same task as req_2417 — the user's clarification that the mesh-health validator is a momentary contextual guard (live-with-it-or-revert-now), NOT a source that should feed a persistent ERR/WARN counter, so the counter has nothing legitimate to count and must be removed rather than wired. Acted on exactly that: deleted the fake ERR/WARN dock badge + its hardcoded validationReadout stub/type. Fix committed 308d04e39.
